name: LDL 2027
overview: League of Legends Development League 2027, LPL's confirmed Tier 2 regional ecosystem. Its 8 confirmed teams are each distinct competitive entities from their LPL Tier 1 parent organizations, even where a parent/affiliate relationship is recorded; three (EDG Youth Team, LGD Young Team, WE Academy) remain active despite their parent organizations' exit from active 2027 LPL Tier 1 competition. No automatic Tier 1 promotion or automatic international qualification exists for any LDL team.
